title: The Cold Echo
author: Jonah Brightwater
blurb: Ansel Oyelaran, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
